object.name: evi.ladder.poles~
object.digest: TPT nonlinear transistor Ladder filter emulation with switchable (interpolated) poles
object.description: By default another 24dB Ladder emulation via piecewise approximation, but poles can be interpolated to a 18dB, 12dB and 6dB filter. These are not allpass aligned so technically incorrect, but sound interesting and can be useful. For a 'correct' 12dB ladder see <o>evi.lorez~</o> (with a 'z').
object.discussion: For more information about other nonlinear Ladder filters in evieve, see the 'evieve ladder' tab of the helpfile.

inlets.description: Cutoff frequency in Pitch or Hz (default) depending on the @cutoffmode attribute.
Self oscillates at resonance==1 but can take higher resonance with a little loss in tuning.

outlets.description: Ladderish output between 24dB..6dB depending on @slope attribute.

attributes.name: cutoffmode
attributes.description: Switch cutoff frequency (inlet 2) between Pitch (on) or Hz (default off).

attributes.name: shape
attributes.description: The 'shape' of the saturation. This attribute should be ignored and left at default.

attributes.name: shapesmooth
attributes.description: If shapesmooth > 0, the @shape attribute will be internally smoothed by this time. Default off and can be safely ignored.

attributes.name: slopesmooth
attributes.description: If slopesmooth > 0, the @slope attribute will be internally smoothed by this time.
